name: Waifu Academy
source: You play as a student who schemes to get perverted revenge on all those who ruined the life and reputation of his late father. This includes members of your own family, other students and school staff.
translation: 你扮演一名学生，计划对所有毁掉他已故父亲的生活和声誉的人进行变态报复。这包括你自己的家庭成员、其他学生和学校工作人员。
